title: Gas Laws Study Game — Under Pressure with ItsDrDan
author: Dr. Dan (ItsDrDan)
description: Responsive gas-law practice with Gas Theory, Changing Conditions, Mixtures & Wet Gases, Ideal Gas Lab, Mystery Gas, Mixed Practice, and a 10-question readiness check. CHEM 1A adds RMS speed, molecular-speed distributions, Graham’s law of effusion, more advanced gas-mixture calculations, and coefficient-box reaction stoichiometry. Uses atm, mmHg, torr, kelvin conversions, mL/L conversions, Dalton’s law, mole fractions, gas collection over water, ideal-gas molar mass and density, and common gas identification. CHEM 3A Ideal Gas Lab includes 15% guided reaction questions; optional real-gas challenges occur in 3% of CHEM 1A Mixed Practice and are excluded from the quiz. Includes guided steps, solution maps, completed work, hints, answer reveals, homework-style unit entry, scientific notation input, scoring, streaks, XP, celebrations, a particle playground, an embedded ItsDrDan lesson, and performance-based study recommendations.
